title: Cyrus and the Ledger
author: Lena Thackeray
blurb: Ines Oyelaran, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
